# Isolde Pembroke

## Overview

- **Age:** 16-17 years old during her initial academy years
- **Gender:** Female
- **Status:** Alive
- **Rank:** Academy Student / Noble Heiress
- **Origin:** House Pembroke
- **Role:** Student at the Royal Academy
- **Titles:** Heiress of House Pembroke

## Appearance

Isolde is a strikingly elegant young noblewoman with refined features and a poised posture that reflects her highborn lineage. She has long, neat hair and presents herself with immaculate grooming and dignified aristocratic attire. Her sharp, attentive eyes give her an intense, commanding presence during academic and combat exercises.

## Personality

Isolde is proud, dutiful, and fiercely committed to upholding the honor of her noble house. She holds exceptionally high standards for herself and those around her, which can initially make her appear cold or aloof. Despite her stern demeanor, she possesses a deep sense of justice and genuine loyalty to her companions once they earn her respect.

## Traits

- Proud and dignified
- Dutiful
- High sense of personal honor
- Fear of bringing shame to her family line

## Abilities

- Advanced elemental magic proficiency
- Noble etiquette and leadership
- Tactical spellcasting

## Goals

- Bring honor to House Pembroke through top academic and martial achievements
- Protect her allies and uphold order within the academy

## History

Isolde enrolled in the academy as a top-tier candidate, quickly establishing herself as one of the most capable students in her year. Early in her academic career, she maintained a strict distance from lower-ranked students, prioritizing her studies and noble obligations. As various crises and combat practicals unfolded at the academy, she frequently found herself fighting alongside her peers, gradually learning to trust their unique talents despite their unconventional methods. Across the events leading up to Volume 4, Isolde demonstrated great bravery during unexpected security threats to the student body, proving her capability in real combat and cementing her role as a dependable student leader.

## Background by volume

- Raised as the primary heir of the prestigious Pembroke noble family
- Trained rigorously in magic and noble decorum from an early age prior to enrolling in the Royal Academy

## Affiliations

- House Pembroke — Daughter and Heiress
- Royal Academy — Student
